engineering.verdict: Real, tested, production software - but sitting just BELOW its own Tier P target band, and the reason is specific.

evidence_run_today.lint: npm run lint -> exit 0, no problems
evidence_run_today.typecheck: npm run typecheck -> exit 0, no errors (strict)
evidence_run_today.tests: npm test -> 1836 passed across 214 files, exit 0
evidence_run_today.build: npm run build -> exit 0, webpack production build

met: Real business-logic tests, not a smoke suite - 214 files covering suppression, send governance, per-mailbox caps, warm-up ramp, unsubscribe rails, bounce policy and reply matching, with genuine fail-closed assertions
Merge-blocking CI gate, branch protection on main
Automated deploy via Entra OIDC with a post-deploy health check, verified by commit rather than liveness
Secrets gitignored; .env.example is the committed template
Error monitoring wired (Sentry server + edge configs)
not_met: NO e2e coverage of critical journey J5 - enrol, launch, send, reply, opt-out. The Playwright suite covers authentication, staff role boundaries and outbound-email detail; it does not cover the journey that actually reaches a third party's inbox. This is the single biggest reason this is not a 9.
Coverage thresholds are NOT verified as enforced. A test:coverage script exists; whether CI fails below a threshold was not checked today, so it is not claimed.
Sentry is configured but I did not verify it is RECEIVING events in production. Wired is not the same as live.
engineering.why_not_higher: The standard is explicit that a 9 requires strict typecheck, lint, real tests AND enforced coverage, e2e on critical journeys, live error monitoring, gitignored secrets, a merge-blocking CI gate, and automated deploy plus health check - ALL present and passing. Three of those are unproven or absent. Rounding to 8.5 to land inside the tier band would be exactly the false-9 the protocol exists to prevent.
engineering.why_not_lower: 1836 genuine tests with fail-closed assertions on the send path is not a scaffold. Every gate that was run, passed.

customer_ready.status: GRADED 2026-08-23 by walking the integrate/monday-pilot build in Chromium with a real session (13 pages, all HTTP 200, zero console errors)
customer_ready.cap_note: The previous 4.0 was CAPPED for a broken core journey - production minting unsubscribe links on the app domain. That defect is fixed and tested on this branch (e61cbde), so the cap no longer applies. Every other cap was checked and none applies: no leakage (BC-01 green and proven to catch one), no customer-facing dev-isms, no placeholder content, health check and monitoring present.
customer_ready.limitation: Walked a FIXTURE database of four near-empty workspaces, not production with seventeen real clients. Strong evidence about empty states, weak about data scale. Two prior findings (Campaigns column reading 0, and the sends contradiction at production scale) could be neither confirmed nor refuted.
top_blockers: Bounce rate cannot be trusted: detection is ON in production yet reports 0% across 1,209 sends. The domain brief makes <2% non-negotiable.
The product shows two truths about one client - Overview reads "Activity - not started" while Activity reads "EMAILS SENT 1". Two sources of truth.
The core job (compose to send to reply) was never walked end to end on this build.
E-06: one mailbox on two workspaces duplicates raw inbound mail including body text.
Art.28 DPAs unverified with Sentry, RocketReach and Resend.

sell_gate.result: NOT SATISFIED. Fix the lower grade first: Customer-Ready. The single highest-impact action is to review, merge and deploy feat/zero-dns-send-profile, which removes the app-domain unsubscribe links from production. Push and deploy remain blocked.
